comments: Registered as one bank on the arch base; the source pivot x is the centre of the arch.
The stage plays closed and open; the opening frames are imported and approved but the rules keep no opening clock to play them with.
geometry: Collision is one tile and belongs to the rules; art never sets a hitbox. The stage stamps the frame centred on the tile centre.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: bars fully down (closed-0), four bar tips under the arch (open-0), bars raised a quarter, a half and three quarters (opening-0..2).

pieces.label: open-0: four bar tips peek below arch.
pieces.name: open-0

pieces.label: opening-0: bars raised about one quarter.
pieces.name: opening-0

pieces.label: opening-2: bars raised about three quarters.
pieces.name: opening-2

size_basis: native canvas 16x16, anchor bottom-centre (8,16); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 16x16; a gate is one tile.
timing: closed 12 ticks; open 6 ticks; opening 3x4 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox (collision is one tile).
